# Helping *Hometown* **Grocers**
# Across America Thrive

For more than 107 years, we’ve helped hometown grocers — from national chains to single-store
operators — serve their communities. Through innovative supply chain solutions, quality products and
services, and trusted retail experiences, we help keep shelves stocked and families fed across the
country.

## Our Stores & Services

[ View All Services ][79]

### Financial Services

Discover how our comprehensive financial services, including payroll, accounts payable, tax
consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

[ About Financial Services ][80]

### Food Safety Services

As a food solutions company that has earned consumer trust for more than 107 years, C&S understands
the importance of having rigorous standards and training for food safety.

[ About Food Safety Services ][81]

### Marketing Services

C&S offers marketing support to elevate your brand, including cutting-edge technology and
industry-leading insights — all designed to enhance your promotional strategies, from digital
advertising to community engagement.

[ About Marketing Services ][82]

### Pharmacy Solutions

Our pharmacy services leverage collective buying power across 2,500 independent pharmacies to
guarantee lower operational costs for you and better health outcomes for the community you serve. 

[ About Pharmacy Solutions ][83]

### Our Stores

The C&S family of companies includes more than 200 grocery stores in 12 states, in addition to
dozens of pharmacies and fuel centers with convenience stores.

[ About Our Stores ][84]

### OurBrands

OurBrands are carried in company-operated stores and are distributed to our independent retail
customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

[ About OurBrands ][85]

## Our Impact

## Committed to Communities Beyond the Store

At C&S Wholesale Grocers, the families we serve are at the core of everything we do, from combating
hunger to safeguarding the environment. We collaborate with organizations nationwide to make a
lasting impact on the communities where we live and work.

# Deeply nourishing from the outside in

We believe great food starts outside on pasture where animals graze freely on organic grass the way
nature intended. Because that’s the kind of wholesome food that fuels your body. The kind of food
you can feel good about loving and sharing with the ones you love. Food that nourishes your mind,
body, and soul.

## Goodness From the Ground Up

### New Snack Sticks!

[Learn more][6]

### New Butter with Olive Oil!

Try our pasture-raised butter blended with organic olive oil for a rich, buttery flavor that's easy
to spread right out of the fridge.

[Learn more][7]

generation of organic farmers!

[Learn more][8]

Introducing New Organic Valley^{®} Protein Plus^{™} Ultra-Filtered Milk! Pasture-raised goodness

## What Makes Us Different (And Why It Makes a Difference)

All of our food is produced on farms that use
* No antibiotics or artificial growth hormones
* No GMOs
* No synthetic pesticides and herbicides

## But there’s even more behind our label:
* [Original Organic Valley farmers milking their cow.]
  
  ### We’re the OGs of Organic
  
  Before the USDA created official standards, we were already living by our own. In 1988, the word
  “organic” wasn’t regulated. It was more of a philosophy than a label. So we set out to make it
  mean something. Our founding farmers set some of the earliest organic guidelines — ones that
  helped shape today’s national standards.
* ### USDA Certified Organic
  
  Everything our co-op produces and sells under our *Organic Valley*^{®} brand is USDA Certified
  Organic. It isn’t the easiest way to produce food, but we believe it’s the best way. Of course,
  that doesn’t stop us from exploring new ways to improve upon our time-honored methods.
  
  [Old metal organic farm sign that says do not spray.]
* [A young boy watching a caterpillar crawl on a leaf. ]
  
  ### Protecting Your Food (And Where it Comes From)
  
  Organic Valley is protecting over 1,500 organic farms spanning hundreds of thousands of acres of
  organic farmland across the country. That’s land that is protected from toxic pesticides and home
  to countless plants and animals — land that can help reverse the effects of climate change.
* ### We’re a Farmer-Owned Cooperative
  
  The people who milk the cows, tend the land, and care for the animals are the same people who own
  the cooperative. We’re invested in doing things the right way, not cutting corners for a profit.
  Our farmers get a fair price for what they produce, animals are treated with care, and you get
  food that’s organic, not organic-ish.
  
  [Farmers having a meeting in a barn with haybales and a tractor.]
* [A close up of a cows mouth eating lush green pasture. ]
  
  ### Our Cows Spend More Time Outside
  
  A lot of dairy cows never see a blade of grass.** Because our farms are certified USDA organic,**
  our cows get year-round access to the outdoors when the weather is safe, and spend more than 120
  days grazing on pasture each year — feeling sunshine, grazing freely, and producing milk that’s
  packed with nutrition.
* ### Small Herds. Big Care.
  
  Our average herd size is just 70 cows, which is much smaller than the national herd size average.
  This means our farmers spend a lot of time tending to and caring for their farms and the life on
  those farms and can spot subtle changes quickly — like a cow eating less or lagging behind the
  herd — this helps address potential issues right away.
  
  [Organic Valley cows walking to pasture. ]

## Our Farmers Start with 4 Simple Ingredients

Fresh air, sunshine, clean water, and soil rich with life. Because when you keep it simple, food
tastes simply amazing.

[Female farmer Christianson standing in the pasture with cows.]

## THE ORGANIC PROMISE

Here’s what you’re choosing when you choose Stonyfield Organic:

Yogurt that has high-quality ingredients, is held to the rigorous organic standard, and is made
without the use of toxic persistent pesticides.

Yogurt made with milk from cows that are required to be on pasture for no fewer than 120 days per
year, as they’re meant to be.

Yogurt that tastes the way creamy, luscious yogurt should because of its quality, not shortcuts.

their businesses.

food, and stronger communities.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

[AGCO Launches PTx, a Precision Ag Portfolio to Accelerate Technology Transformation]

Milk is the only easily accessible wholesome food that provides 18 of the 22 essential nutrients
needed by the human body. Akshayakalpa Organic is India’s first certified organic dairy enterprise
bringing together a balance of practices based in science and the traditional heritage of dairy
farming since the last 16 years. We are also the first in the country to test milk for antibiotics
at the farm and plant level and this is a practice we follow till date. What is left OUT of our milk
and dairy products is what makes them healthier, tastier and full of essential nutrients.
Akshayakalpa Organic milk is free from man-made bad and full of nature-made good, real milk from
stress-free cows – making it the ideal dietary addition to meet everyday nutrition goals.

We believe in farming for the future. Alongside a mindful approach to agriculture, we are concerned
with protecting the environment and working in harmony of the existing eco-systems. We strive to
maintain the integrity of the land and respect for its produce. We constantly strive to see how we
can make our farms, offices and facilities more sustainable, more balanced.

At the heart of our organization is our community of rural farmers. Our farmer entrepreneurship
initiatives ensure that every bit of harvest from our farms are true to the land and to you, while
restoring the dignity and respect the farming profession deserves.

Whatever nutrition journey you may be on now for you and family, we trust that once you embrace the
goodness of Akshayakalpa Organic, your body will thank you for it!

### Self-sustaining farms

We follow practices of co-existence farming. The resources required by the farm to thrive are
harnesses within the farm itself. Cow dung is used to generate methane gas used for day-to-day
activities at the farms. The residue goes back to the soil as fertilizer for our lands. No
artificial fertilizers or pesticides are used, maintaining the vitality of the soil at our farms.
[Akshayakalpa co-existence farming, self-sustaining practices, methane from cow dung, and preserving
soil vitality.]

### Happy home

Our farms provide not just shelters, but a stress-free home for our cows. We make sure our cows have
access to clean water and organic fodder as and when they need it. With an open and dedicated
paddock area, our cows are healthy, happy, and free.

our promise of providing wealth-generation opportunities and a stable source of daily income for the
farmers and their families.

### Self-sustaining farms

We follow practices of co-existence farming. The resources required by the farm to thrive are
harnesses within the farm itself. Cow dung is used to generate methane gas used for day-to-day
activities at the farms. The residue goes back to the soil as fertilizer for our lands. No
artificial fertilizers or pesticides are used, maintaining the vitality of the soil at our farms.

## [About Carwari][51]

We are a leading certified organic manufacturer of sesame seed products in Australia.


Our signature product is "Black Tahini (Black Sesame Paste)" which is ground by a large stone mill.
All of our Tahini products are very smooth and creamy. 


We also have a wide and diverse range of nuts, seeds, grain products and certified organic Japanese
condiments which are made in Japan.


For more story about us, please click [here][52].

Help Make Organic the Norm!

# CCOF - California Certified Organic Farmers

CCOF is a nonprofit organization that advances organic agriculture for a healthy world through
organic certification, education, advocacy, and promotion. We envision a world where organic is the
norm.

[ Get Certified ][171] [ Donate ][172]

From field to fork, we're growing a future where organic is the norm.

## Supporting Organic Professionals

## Getting Started

We are your partner as you navigate the complicated world of organic certification.

[ Get Certified ][173]

## Staying Certified

Use our Resource Library, MyCCOF portal, videos, podcasts, and more.

[ Resources ][174]

## Advocating for You

We keep you in the loop on policy updates and represent organic producers at the state and national
levels.

[ Advocacy ][175]

## Grants

The CCOF Foundation offers financial support for students, farmers transitioning to organic, and
producers facing hardship.

[ Grants ][176]

## Interested in going organic?

### Join our free weekly Organic Office Hours to learn everything about transitioning to organic,
### staying in compliance & more. All questions & experience levels welcome!

[ Learn More! ][177]

## Why Organic?

Organic creates jobs, sequesters carbon, keeps water clean, and reduces our exposure to toxic
pesticides. Learn about the economic, social, and environmental benefits of organic.

[ The science behind organic ][178] [ What is organic? ][179]
Paicines Ranch Soil by Liz Birnbaum at the Curated Feast

## Our organic community

From grocery shoppers to farmers and retailers, organic offers benefits to everyone.

## Directory

Use our interactive listing of over 4,000 California Certified Organic Farmers certified organic
producers and handlers.

[ Directory ][180]

## Organic News

Stay up-to-date with the top organic news.

[ News ][181]

## Understanding Organic Labels

Learn how to find the foods and products you can trust.

[ How to Read Labels ][182]

## USDA Organic Certification - How it Works

Achieving USDA organic certification shouldn't be intimidating or confusing. In this video, CCOF
walks you through the organic certification process, how to apply, what to expect, and how we
support you from start to finish. CCOF has helped people like you get organic certified for over 50
years!

Help Make Organic the Norm!

# CCOF - California Certified Organic Farmers

CCOF is a nonprofit organization that advances organic agriculture for a healthy world through
organic certification, education, advocacy, and promotion. We envision a world where organic is the
norm.

[ Get Certified ][171] [ Donate ][172]

From field to fork, we're growing a future where organic is the norm.

## Supporting Organic Professionals

## Getting Started

We are your partner as you navigate the complicated world of organic certification.

[ Get Certified ][173]

## Staying Certified

Use our Resource Library, MyCCOF portal, videos, podcasts, and more.

[ Resources ][174]

## Advocating for You

We keep you in the loop on policy updates and represent organic producers at the state and national
levels.

[ Advocacy ][175]

## Grants

The CCOF Foundation offers financial support for students, farmers transitioning to organic, and
producers facing hardship.

[ Grants ][176]

## Interested in going organic?

### Join our free weekly Organic Office Hours to learn everything about transitioning to organic,
### staying in compliance & more. All questions & experience levels welcome!

[ Learn More! ][177]

## Why Organic?

Organic creates jobs, sequesters carbon, keeps water clean, and reduces our exposure to toxic
pesticides. Learn about the economic, social, and environmental benefits of organic.

[ The science behind organic ][178] [ What is organic? ][179]
Paicines Ranch Soil by Liz Birnbaum at the Curated Feast

## Our organic community

From grocery shoppers to farmers and retailers, organic offers benefits to everyone.

## Directory

Use our interactive listing of over 4,000 California Certified Organic Farmers certified organic
producers and handlers.

[ Directory ][180]

## Organic News

Stay up-to-date with the top organic news.

[ News ][181]

## Understanding Organic Labels

Learn how to find the foods and products you can trust.

[ How to Read Labels ][182]

## USDA Organic Certification - How it Works

Achieving USDA organic certification shouldn't be intimidating or confusing. In this video, CCOF
walks you through the organic certification process, how to apply, what to expect, and how we
support you from start to finish. CCOF has helped people like you get organic certified for over 50
years!

# Certification

## Our certification programs

Control Union Certifications offers tailored or pre-made certification programs for sustainable
sourcing in many industries. Here you will find an overview of all our certification programs
offered worldwide. You can easily filter to your specific needs, industry or location. Let Control
Union be the proof to your promise.

[ To all Certification Programs ][219]
[Certifications]

## Getting certified in 5 steps

Control Union Certifications aims to provide assurance and confidence to all interested parties that
a product, process, service or organisation that it certified fulfils the requirements of the
relevant inspection or certification standard. It’s for that reason that the certification process
is laid down in procedures, which describes the entire process, from application to certificate
issuance and who is qualified to conduct such activities.

[ All our certification programs ][220]

#### Request a certification or verification

Click on the ‘apply now’ link on the specific certification program page to begin the application
process. Is the link missing? Please contact us, and we can send you a separate application form to
be filled and returned to us. The verification programs will include an application process.

#### Receive the offer letter

Once we have your application(s), we will provide you with an offer letter that will indicate the
price and scope of your certification.

#### Accept and get your audit plan

Upon accepting and signing, we will contact you about setting up dates for your audit. Once an
auditor is assigned to your audit, an agenda and audit plan will be sent to prepare for your audit.
At the close of your audit, the auditor will indicate if any non-compliances have been found and
agree to the deadlines of the corrective actions.

#### Audit review

Your audit results will be reviewed by a secondary person, called the certifier, who ultimately
decides whether certification will be granted. If you had corrective actions to approach, these need
to be sent in for the review process to begin.

#### Get your Certification / Get your attestation or score that has been reported.

If the results have been approved, you will be contacted to receive your certification. If the
results were not satisfactory, you will need to submit your corrective actions within the agreed
time frame or pause your certification until such time as you are ready. For verifications, If
results are not satisfactory, you will be required to wait a period of time to begin the process
again.

##### Why Control Union Certifications

## A solid international partner

By understanding the challenges of our clients and their supply chains, as well as the need for
increasing transparency and stakeholder involvement, Control Union Certifications has developed
services that can be bundled together to best meet the particular needs of our clients.

auditor is assigned to your audit, an agenda and audit plan will be sent to prepare for your audit.
At the close of your audit, the auditor will indicate if any non-compliances have been found and
agree to the deadlines of the corrective actions.

#### Audit review

Your audit results will be reviewed by a secondary person, called the certifier, who ultimately
decides whether certification will be granted. If you had corrective actions to approach, these need
to be sent in for the review process to begin.

#### Get your Certification / Get your attestation or score that has been reported.

If the results have been approved, you will be contacted to receive your certification. If the
results were not satisfactory, you will need to submit your corrective actions within the agreed
time frame or pause your certification until such time as you are ready. For verifications, If
results are not satisfactory, you will be required to wait a period of time to begin the process
again.

increasing transparency and stakeholder involvement, Control Union Certifications has developed
services that can be bundled together to best meet the particular needs of our clients.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education

used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the

business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant

# The Class Produce Group

We are a family-owned and operated business that distributes only the freshest fruits and highest
quality vegetables to produce partners up and down the East Coast. Proudly serving the Mid-Atlantic
since 1936, we have built our business on reputation, quality, dependability, and service!
[Fresh Fruit & Vegetables][23]

# Organic Program

We're passionate about organic produce and the benefits they provide to consumers and to the
environment. That's why we partner with the best local growers to offer the highest quality,
certified organic products!
[Organics][24]

# CPG Fresh Cuts

Who loves saving time in the kitchen? We do, and we know you do too! That's why we launched CPG
Fresh Cuts, our Fresh Cut Processing program that distributes fresh, pre-sliced fruits and
vegetables!
[Fresh Cut Processing][25]
[Wholesale Produce]

##### Wholesale Produce

We are a wholesale company and not a grower; therefore, we can choose from whom we buy our products.
We only buy from the best growers who pack superior quality!
[CPG Fresh Cuts]

##### CPG Fresh Cuts

We offer a limitless product line of fresh cut fruits and vegetables. Operating out of a modern,
state-of-the-art facility on our campus, we provide full service processing for some of the top
names in the industry!
[Locally Sourced]

##### Locally Sourced

We are proudly committed to sourcing local fruits and vegetables! Our local sourcing program allows
us to keep produce prices down and provide affordable selections that are fresh and healthful. Our
passion for partnering with local farmers gives us the ability to support local economies, provide
fresh food offerings, reduce shipping costs, and lessen our carbon footprint! [VIEW OUR LOCAL BOOK
[PDF]][26]
[Fruit Baskets]

##### Fruit Baskets

Show you're thinking of them and you care! Your gift of a Class Produce Group Fruit basket is a
great way to say "Get Well, Thank You or Congratulations!" Our tradition of excellence has been
extended to include a great selection of fruit baskets to meet your needs and delight the recipient!
* Address: 8477 Dorsey Run Road. Jessup, MD 20794-2003 | Phone: 410-799-5700 | Fax: 1-410-799-0047
* © 2026 The Class Produce Group. All Rights Reserved.

We are a family-owned and operated business that distributes only the freshest fruits and highest
quality vegetables to produce partners up and down the East Coast. Proudly serving the Mid-Atlantic
since 1936, we have built our business on reputation, quality, dependability, and service!
[Fresh Fruit & Vegetables][23]

# Organic Program

We're passionate about organic produce and the benefits they provide to consumers and to the
environment. That's why we partner with the best local growers to offer the highest quality,
certified organic products!
[Organics][24]

# CPG Fresh Cuts

Who loves saving time in the kitchen? We do, and we know you do too! That's why we launched CPG
Fresh Cuts, our Fresh Cut Processing program that distributes fresh, pre-sliced fruits and
vegetables!
[Fresh Cut Processing][25]
[Wholesale Produce]

##### Wholesale Produce

We are a wholesale company and not a grower; therefore, we can choose from whom we buy our products.
We only buy from the best growers who pack superior quality!
[CPG Fresh Cuts]

##### CPG Fresh Cuts

We offer a limitless product line of fresh cut fruits and vegetables. Operating out of a modern,
state-of-the-art facility on our campus, we provide full service processing for some of the top
names in the industry!
[Locally Sourced]

##### Locally Sourced

We are proudly committed to sourcing local fruits and vegetables! Our local sourcing program allows
us to keep produce prices down and provide affordable selections that are fresh and healthful. Our
passion for partnering with local farmers gives us the ability to support local economies, provide
fresh food offerings, reduce shipping costs, and lessen our carbon footprint! [VIEW OUR LOCAL BOOK
[PDF]][26]
[Fruit Baskets]

##### Fruit Baskets

Show you're thinking of them and you care! Your gift of a Class Produce Group Fruit basket is a
great way to say "Get Well, Thank You or Congratulations!" Our tradition of excellence has been
extended to include a great selection of fruit baskets to meet your needs and delight the recipient!

Desigo® Milk Reservation prioritizes new families with maternity needs or children under 18, as this
generation requires special attention in today's world where quality natural nutrition is limited
and scarce. However, reservations are open to everyone, recognizing that milk nutrition is essential
for all age groups, including adults and those planning to have children. These priorities ensure
that our limited production reaches those who can make the most significant impact for a healthier
India.



Reserved members gain access to 100% milk traceability through their phones. A unique ID will be
created for each member to monitor all aspects of Desigo® Milk, including daily farm activities and
beyond.

**Every leader has a story. The most powerful ones know how to tell it—and how to live it.**

authenticity, confidence, and impact. My coaching blends powerful questions, deep listening, and the
transformative art of storytelling to help clients gain clarity, navigate change, and lead with

Whether we’re preparing for a high-stakes presentation, exploring a career transition, strengthening
leadership presence, or rediscovering your authentic voice, my goal is simple: to help you see the
story within—and use it to create the life and leadership you want.

People often worry about the pesticides they eat – but pesticides’ harms go beyond that, to the
farmworkers and communities in their path. Users of pesticides like glyphosate have begun to sue
producers for liability in their cancers. These cases touch on questions about who is harmed by
chemical-intensive agriculture, and who pays the price.

## Agroecology Uprooted

With food systems and the planet in crisis, what would true resilient, sustainable, and just
solutions look like? The answer may lie in a method called [agroecology][36], a holistic approach to
food, agriculture, nature, and social systems that’s already taking root around the globe.

All five episodes of our latest podcast miniseries are now available to stream.

[Listen now][37]

## We approach our work from a systems perspective.

IATP understands the interconnection between agriculture, trade and climate.

[an illustration of two links, linked together.]
We analyze issue interdependence.

We see how interrelationships between issues within complex societal structures make it challenging
to effect change but also open powerful opportunities.

[An illustration of connected dots. ]
We unpack power dynamics.

We ask who has the power? Who wins and loses? Who is at the table when decisions are made?

[An illustration of a network]
We identify key levers of change.

We identify opportunities for big changes within trade, agriculture and climate policy. And we
propose bold solutions that will bring us closer to our vision.

[What is systems thinking? ][38]
[American flags in front of U.S. capitol]

## Eyes on the Trump Administration

As we navigate the changing political landscape, IATP remains committed to our principles, including
evidence, public accountability and human dignity. We have created a hub for our work tracking the
administration’s actions and analyzing their impacts.

Mecalux is one of the world’s leading intralogistics technology companies. It is at the cutting edge

# MVOAI

MVOAI is committed to reestablishing the peace between farming, consciousness and the Laws of
Nature. Our food is certified and marketed under Maharishi Vedic Organic Agriculture, Vedic
principle-based and the highest organic standards.

[ Apply for Certification ][32]

##### Beyond Organic Standards

We combine strict international organic standards and Vedic agricultural wisdom to create food that
is of the highest purity, energy and nutritional value.

##### Certification with Integrity

We accredit and inspect manufacturers to make sure that they follow USDA Organic, International
Organic and Maharishi Vedic Agriculture standards.

##### Consciousness-Based Farming

Our agronomy encourages agronomy in line with Natural Law, improving the soil health, the health of
plants and the environment.

##### Global Impact & Poverty Reduction

Vedic Organic cooperatives and international collaboration empower us to provide sustainable farming
initiatives, which empower communities across the globe.

[pexels-tomfisk-5197443]

About us

## Agriculture in Harmony with Natural Law

MVOAI had been established as a vision to bring back all the knowledge of Natural Law in
agriculture. We think food is more than chemical composition, it is a manifestation of nature
intelligence. Through integrating organic farming and Maharishi Vedic technologies, we will create
food that is healthy to the body, the mind and the environment.
* Commercial Gardening
* Residential Gardening
* Industrial Gardening

[ Learn More ][33]

Our Services

## Comprehensive Certification & Education

##### USDA Organic Certification

Certification of the producers, who are operating under the United States standards of National
Organic Program.

##### International Organic Certification

International certification of producers who wish to be compliant in the international markets.

##### Maharishi Vedic Agriculture Certification

Elective sophisticated certification that acknowledges adherence to Maharishi Vedic agricultural
principles and practices.

##### Research & Scientific Studies

Scientific research on the benefits of Vedic Organic Agriculture and support and collaboration.

##### Global Institute Development

Advice and help in setting up affiliated Vedic Organic Agriculture Institutes around the globe.

##### Farmer Education & Training

Training and materials to assist farmers who want to use Vedic Organic practices.

Why Us

## What Is Missing in Modern Agriculture?

The importance of the relationship between consciousness and the Natural Law in modern agriculture
is frequently ignored. As a result, food systems face:
* Environmental imbalance
* Soil degradation
* Reduced nutrient density
* Economic instability for farmers

MVOAI fills this lost dimension, which guarantees the balance, vitality, and sustainability in the
long run.

[ Learn the Difference ][34]

Testimonials

## Trusted by Farmers, Producers & Global Partners

##### Ireneo Marchesi

— Certified Organic Producer, Europe

MVOAI certification helped us align our farming practices with both international organic standards
and deeper principles of sustainability. The result has been healthier soil, stronger crops, and
increased market trust.”

##### Monica R. Wright

— Organic Farm Cooperative Member, South America

“Since adopting Maharishi Vedic Organic principles, we’ve seen improved crop consistency and greater
environmental balance on our farm. The certification process was thorough, supportive, and truly
educational.”

Our Highlights

consciousness-based agriculture enriches food vitality and health ...
[Read More][37]
[Science][38]

## [Scientific Evidence: 600+ Peer-Reviewed Studies on Vedic Agriculture][39]

Explore the scientific validation behind Vedic agriculture through over 600 peer-reviewed studies.
Learn how consciousness-based farming fosters purity and quality ...
[Read More][40]

# MVOAI

MVOAI is committed to reestablishing the peace between farming, consciousness and the Laws of
Nature. Our food is certified and marketed under Maharishi Vedic Organic Agriculture, Vedic
principle-based and the highest organic standards.

[ Apply for Certification ][32]

##### Beyond Organic Standards

We combine strict international organic standards and Vedic agricultural wisdom to create food that
is of the highest purity, energy and nutritional value.

##### Certification with Integrity

We accredit and inspect manufacturers to make sure that they follow USDA Organic, International
Organic and Maharishi Vedic Agriculture standards.

##### Consciousness-Based Farming

Our agronomy encourages agronomy in line with Natural Law, improving the soil health, the health of
plants and the environment.

##### Global Impact & Poverty Reduction

Vedic Organic cooperatives and international collaboration empower us to provide sustainable farming
initiatives, which empower communities across the globe.

[pexels-tomfisk-5197443]

About us

## Agriculture in Harmony with Natural Law

MVOAI had been established as a vision to bring back all the knowledge of Natural Law in
agriculture. We think food is more than chemical composition, it is a manifestation of nature
intelligence. Through integrating organic farming and Maharishi Vedic technologies, we will create
food that is healthy to the body, the mind and the environment.
* Commercial Gardening
* Residential Gardening
* Industrial Gardening

[ Learn More ][33]

Our Services

## Comprehensive Certification & Education

##### USDA Organic Certification

Certification of the producers, who are operating under the United States standards of National
Organic Program.

##### International Organic Certification

International certification of producers who wish to be compliant in the international markets.

##### Maharishi Vedic Agriculture Certification

Elective sophisticated certification that acknowledges adherence to Maharishi Vedic agricultural
principles and practices.

##### Research & Scientific Studies

Scientific research on the benefits of Vedic Organic Agriculture and support and collaboration.

##### Global Institute Development

Advice and help in setting up affiliated Vedic Organic Agriculture Institutes around the globe.

##### Farmer Education & Training

Training and materials to assist farmers who want to use Vedic Organic practices.

Why Us

## What Is Missing in Modern Agriculture?

The importance of the relationship between consciousness and the Natural Law in modern agriculture
is frequently ignored. As a result, food systems face:
* Environmental imbalance
* Soil degradation
* Reduced nutrient density
* Economic instability for farmers

MVOAI fills this lost dimension, which guarantees the balance, vitality, and sustainability in the
long run.

[ Learn the Difference ][34]

Testimonials

## Trusted by Farmers, Producers & Global Partners

##### Ireneo Marchesi

— Certified Organic Producer, Europe

MVOAI certification helped us align our farming practices with both international organic standards
and deeper principles of sustainability. The result has been healthier soil, stronger crops, and
increased market trust.”

##### Monica R. Wright

— Organic Farm Cooperative Member, South America

“Since adopting Maharishi Vedic Organic principles, we’ve seen improved crop consistency and greater
environmental balance on our farm. The certification process was thorough, supportive, and truly
educational.”

Our Highlights

consciousness-based agriculture enriches food vitality and health ...
[Read More][37]
[Science][38]

## [Scientific Evidence: 600+ Peer-Reviewed Studies on Vedic Agriculture][39]

Explore the scientific validation behind Vedic agriculture through over 600 peer-reviewed studies.
Learn how consciousness-based farming fosters purity and quality ...
[Read More][40]

#### [Ask the Vet: What can we do about the new tick in the Northeast, the Asian Longhorned
#### Tick?][99]

[[Ask the Vet: What can we do about the new tick in the Northeast, the Asian Longhorned Tick?]][100]

By Dayna Locitzer, DVM

Unfortunately there is a new tick in town, the Asian Longhorned Tick (ALT). Originally from east
Asia, ALT was first identified in the United States in 2017 but likely has been here since 2010. It
can now be found in over 22 states with the highest prevalence in Virginia and surrounding areas. In
the northeast, it has been found mainly in eastern and southern New York, but also reported in
isolated locations in Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire and Maine. But, its
geographic reach is likely to expand due to a number of factors including climate and habitat change
as well as the movement of animals. ALT carries the disease called Theileriosis, caused by the
blood-borne protozoal parasite Theileria orientalis. Organic dairy cows have a high level of tick
exposure due to the time they spend on pasture and the lack of insecticides used, making it
important to be aware of ALT and Theileriosis.

Succession planning is one of the most consequential decisions a farm family will ever make — and

what we’ve learned: what goes wrong, what goes right, and why waiting too long can cost a family
everything they worked to build. The conversation got honest pretty fast. That’s kind of our
dynamic.

#### [Small Things can have Big Impacts][107]

[[Small Things can have Big Impacts]][108]

Dr. Robert Van Saun, DVM, Penn State Extension Veterinarian

Trace minerals and vitamins comprise a very small portion of an animal’s diet (< 1% of dry matter),
yet they can have a tremendous impact on animal health and performance. When it comes to essential
nutrients to support the dairy animal, cobalt, copper, iron, iodine, manganese, selenium, and zinc
comprise the required trace minerals. These mineral elements are only required at a level of
milligrams (mg; one one-thousandth of a gram) or micrograms (µg; one one-thousandth of a milligram)
per day. It is difficult to appreciate how nutrients required in such small amounts can have a
significant impact on animal health and performance. Similarly, fat-soluble vitamins A, D, and E are
also required in moderate amounts (mg/day). Collectively, these essential nutrients can impact most
aspects of metabolism, antioxidant status, and, most importantly, immune function.

#### [Integrating Grazing Management and Behavioral Responses to Optimize Pasture Utilization][111]

[[Integrating Grazing Management and Behavioral Responses to Optimize Pasture Utilization]][112]

By James Lawhead, DVM and Leoni F. Martins, PhD., The Pennsylvania State University

Numerous factors influence decisions in grazing systems. Cattle number, land availability, soil
types, weather conditions, and animal productivity are some of the key variables directly affecting
pasture management for dairy cows. In grazing systems, the decision of when to graze and how much to
harvest often considers the economic trade-offs between maximizing milk production per animal and
per acre. For instance, increasing the stocking density (number of cows/area) and the grazing
intensity may contribute to maximizing the total amount of forage harvested; however, it could also
limit the productivity of individual cows due to decreased forage quality.

interests of organic dairy producers are represented. Continued advocacy, collaboration, and access
to timely information will be critical to maintaining the resilience and long-term viability of
organic dairy operations throughout the Western United States.

#### [Ask the Vet: What can we do about the new tick in the Northeast, the Asian Longhorned
#### Tick?][99]

[[Ask the Vet: What can we do about the new tick in the Northeast, the Asian Longhorned Tick?]][100]

By Dayna Locitzer, DVM

Unfortunately there is a new tick in town, the Asian Longhorned Tick (ALT). Originally from east
Asia, ALT was first identified in the United States in 2017 but likely has been here since 2010. It
can now be found in over 22 states with the highest prevalence in Virginia and surrounding areas. In
the northeast, it has been found mainly in eastern and southern New York, but also reported in
isolated locations in Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire and Maine. But, its
geographic reach is likely to expand due to a number of factors including climate and habitat change
as well as the movement of animals. ALT carries the disease called Theileriosis, caused by the
blood-borne protozoal parasite Theileria orientalis. Organic dairy cows have a high level of tick
exposure due to the time they spend on pasture and the lack of insecticides used, making it
important to be aware of ALT and Theileriosis.

#### [Small Things can have Big Impacts][107]

[[Small Things can have Big Impacts]][108]

Dr. Robert Van Saun, DVM, Penn State Extension Veterinarian

Trace minerals and vitamins comprise a very small portion of an animal’s diet (< 1% of dry matter),
yet they can have a tremendous impact on animal health and performance. When it comes to essential
nutrients to support the dairy animal, cobalt, copper, iron, iodine, manganese, selenium, and zinc
comprise the required trace minerals. These mineral elements are only required at a level of
milligrams (mg; one one-thousandth of a gram) or micrograms (µg; one one-thousandth of a milligram)
per day. It is difficult to appreciate how nutrients required in such small amounts can have a
significant impact on animal health and performance. Similarly, fat-soluble vitamins A, D, and E are
also required in moderate amounts (mg/day). Collectively, these essential nutrients can impact most
aspects of metabolism, antioxidant status, and, most importantly, immune function.

#### [Integrating Grazing Management and Behavioral Responses to Optimize Pasture Utilization][111]

[[Integrating Grazing Management and Behavioral Responses to Optimize Pasture Utilization]][112]

By James Lawhead, DVM and Leoni F. Martins, PhD., The Pennsylvania State University

Numerous factors influence decisions in grazing systems. Cattle number, land availability, soil
types, weather conditions, and animal productivity are some of the key variables directly affecting
pasture management for dairy cows. In grazing systems, the decision of when to graze and how much to
harvest often considers the economic trade-offs between maximizing milk production per animal and
per acre. For instance, increasing the stocking density (number of cows/area) and the grazing
intensity may contribute to maximizing the total amount of forage harvested; however, it could also
limit the productivity of individual cows due to decreased forage quality.

# Our certifications

OEKO-TEX® standards enable everyone to make responsible decisions and protect natural resources.
Driven by sustainability and a dedication to transparency, our work is grounded in proven science.
Explore our portfolio [here][69] or apply for your chosen certification or service. 

[
[OEKO-TEX® MADE IN GREEN certification]

The MADE IN GREEN label identifies textiles and leather goods tested for harmful substances and
which have been manufactured under sustainable and socially responsible conditions.

][70]
[
[OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certification]

All types of textiles that have been tested for harmful substances, from yarns to the finished
product, may bear the STANDARD 100 product label.

][71]
[
[OEKO-TEX® ORGANIC COTTON certification]

The ORGANIC COTTON certification offers verification from farm to product. Products bearing this
label have been tested for the use of genetically modified organisms (GMOs) and harmful substances.
 

][72]
[
[OEKO-TEX® LEATHER STANDARD certification]

The LEATHER STANDARD label is tailored to leather articles which have been tested for harmful
substances. Certification can be awarded for leather semi-finished products, finished leather,
leather fibre materials up to finished articles and accessories.

][73]
[
[OEKO-TEX® STeP certification]

STeP certifies production facilities which manufacture textile and leather articles under
sustainable production conditions.

][74]
[
[OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT certification]

The ECO PASSPORT identifies chemicals, colourants and auxiliaries used in the textile and leather
industry which are not harmful to health and which are environmentally friendly.

][75]
[
[OEKO-TEX® RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS certification]

RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS supports you on preventing or mitigating existing and potential negative
impacts of business operations within your own activities, your supply chains and your wider
business relationships. 

][76]

# Lasting Value Is Built, Not Found

At Platinum Equity, we invest in companies we believe in and work hard to unlock their potential

[ About Us ][42]
[#inside of a store with counter and people going about their business]

## Who We Are

We are investors. We are operators. We are builders. We are change agents. We are responsible
stewards of capital who manage ~$48 billion of diversified assets. Platinum Equity is a global
investment firm with six offices, ~360 professionals and operating expertise that spans all seven
continents. Our unique combination of people and process, known as M&A&O^{®}, helps turn companies
into market leaders and creates value that lasts.

[Our Firm][43] [OUR PEOPLE][44]
[Two professionals, a man and woman, focusing on a computer screen in a modern office setting,
viewed through a glass window with reflections.]

## 30+

### Years in Business

## 550+

### Acquisitions to Date

## ~$48B

### Assets Under Management

## What We Do

We specialize in private equity and other alternative strategies, investing on behalf of
institutional investors around the world. We generate returns by investing in companies across a
wide range of industries that need financial and operational support to unlock their full potential.

[Private Equity][45] [Credit][46]
[a group of 4 builders walking with hard hats and reflective vests with the text M & A & O placed on
top of the image]

## How We Create Value

Our trademarked M&A&O strategy goes beyond traditional mergers and acquisitions, applying deep
operational expertise to create long-term value for our investors, our companies and the communities
they serve.

[Our companies][47] [Our impact][48]

[ About Us ][42]

## Who We Are

We are investors. We are operators. We are builders. We are change agents. We are responsible
stewards of capital who manage ~$48 billion of diversified assets. Platinum Equity is a global
investment firm with six offices, ~360 professionals and operating expertise that spans all seven
continents. Our unique combination of people and process, known as M&A&O^{®}, helps turn companies
into market leaders and creates value that lasts.

## What We Do

We specialize in private equity and other alternative strategies, investing on behalf of
institutional investors around the world. We generate returns by investing in companies across a

they serve.

# Our Guiding Principles

## TRANSPARENCY

[Guiding-Principles-TRANSPARENCY.jpg]

Anyone is welcome to visit the farm anytime. No trade secrets, no locked doors, every corner is
camera-accessible.

## GRASS-BASED

[Guiding-Principles-Grass-Based-.jpg]

Pastured livestock and poultry, moved frequently to new “salad bars,” offer landscape healing and
nutritional superiority.

## INDIVIDUALITY

[Guiding-Principles-INDIVIDUALITY.jpg]

Plants and animals should be provided a habitat that allows them to express their physiological
distinctiveness. Respecting and honoring the pigness of the pig is a foundation for societal health.

## COMMUNITY

[Guiding-Principles-COMMUNITY.jpg]

We believe in integrity food. We should all seek food closer to home, in our foodshed, our own
bioregion. This means enjoying seasonality and reacquainting ourselves with our home kitchens.

## NATURE’S TEMPLATE

[Guiding-Principles-NATURE’S-TEMPLATE.jpg]

Mimicking natural patterns on a commercial domestic scale insures moral and ethical boundaries to
human cleverness. Cows are herbivores, not omnivores; that is why we’ve never fed them dead cows
like the United States Department of Agriculture encouraged (the alleged cause of mad cows).

## EARTHWORMS

[Guiding-Principles-EARTHWORMS.jpg]

We’re really in the earthworm enhancement business. Stimulating soil biota is our first priority.
Soil health creates healthy food.

# Our Guiding Principles

## TRANSPARENCY

[Guiding-Principles-TRANSPARENCY.jpg]

Anyone is welcome to visit the farm anytime. No trade secrets, no locked doors, every corner is
camera-accessible.

## GRASS-BASED

[Guiding-Principles-Grass-Based-.jpg]

Pastured livestock and poultry, moved frequently to new “salad bars,” offer landscape healing and
nutritional superiority.

## INDIVIDUALITY

[Guiding-Principles-INDIVIDUALITY.jpg]

Plants and animals should be provided a habitat that allows them to express their physiological
distinctiveness. Respecting and honoring the pigness of the pig is a foundation for societal health.

## COMMUNITY

[Guiding-Principles-COMMUNITY.jpg]

We believe in integrity food. We should all seek food closer to home, in our foodshed, our own
bioregion. This means enjoying seasonality and reacquainting ourselves with our home kitchens.

## NATURE’S TEMPLATE

[Guiding-Principles-NATURE’S-TEMPLATE.jpg]

Mimicking natural patterns on a commercial domestic scale insures moral and ethical boundaries to
human cleverness. Cows are herbivores, not omnivores; that is why we’ve never fed them dead cows
like the United States Department of Agriculture encouraged (the alleged cause of mad cows).

## EARTHWORMS

[Guiding-Principles-EARTHWORMS.jpg]

We’re really in the earthworm enhancement business. Stimulating soil biota is our first priority.
Soil health creates healthy food.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

facilities adhering to the strictest GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) standards. This ensures
every ingredient is rigorously tested, and every product meets the highest safety and quality
regulations.
Transparency is paramount. We believe in open communication with our partners, providing you with
complete visibility from concept to shipping. This level of transparency allows you to build
confidence in your brand and the supplements you offer.

Beyond quality and transparency, we offer a reliable turnkey solution. Our comprehensive services
encompass everything you need to bring your supplement vision to life, from initial concept to
finished product. Our team of experts can handle custom formulation, provide expert guidance, design
eye-catching labels, create high-quality packaging, and ensure efficient shipping. This streamlined
approach allows you to focus on what matters most – marketing and building your brand.

[ Get Started ][62]
Reliable Turnkey

#### Services

#### [ Supplement Manufacturing ][63]

Boasting a massive production capacity of 5.5 million capsules daily, Vox Nutrition welcomes you to
tour our state-of-the-art facility!

#### [ Custom Formulas ][64]

Powder, tablets, capsules, gummies – we do it all! Vox Nutrition can manufacture your custom
supplement formula in any format you desire.

#### [ Label Design & Printing ][65]

Our in-house design team collaborates with you to bring your dream supplement brand to life. Vox
Nutrition’s in-house label printing department ensures quality and expedites your labeling needs.

#### [ Variety of Packaging Options ][66]

From sleek and modern to classic and bold, our custom packaging options let you create the perfect
size, shape, and color for your supplement brand.

#### [ Bulk Supplements ][67]

Unparalleled selection, unmatched value! We boasts one of the industry’s largest inventories,
allowing us to offer bulk supplements at the best prices.

#### [ Fulfillment Options ][68]

Seamless fulfillment at your fingertips! Partner with Vox Nutrition and Ship Central Fulfillment to
deliver your supplements directly to your customers.

Supplements. Simplified. Let Vox Nutrition be your private label supplement manufacturer, and focus
on building your brand.

[ Get a Quote Today ][69]
Stay Ahead of the Curve

#### Our Cutting-Edge Supplements

The supplement landscape is constantly evolving. At Vox Nutrition, we stay ahead of the curve by
researching and developing market-ready solutions that cater to the latest health and wellness
trends. But staying trendy isn’t enough. We prioritize quality with rigorous testing procedures to
ensure every product meets the highest standards. Explore our extensive catalog of private label
supplements and discover how Vox Nutrition can empower your brand.
